scope: Main contains the opt-in worker and experimental distributed exporters. No production rollout, live server restart, project modification, push or release. Only owned benchmark apps/volumes were stopped/deleted.
timing_contract: Same two full 1080p/30 frozen originals and H.264 High/stereo AAC/-14 LUFS settings. All allocation after submission, source transfer/cache checks, planning, audio, picture, assembly, full finished-file decoding, timing checks, upload and publication included. Image deployment and snapshot/URL preparation excluded in every trial. Mac delivery separate. Caption trial deliberately changes one caption per video and does not download outputs.
limitations: One successful pair per configuration; hardware allocation, hosts, caches and networks vary.
Four-GPU and caption trials have an eight-CPU-verifier cap; the eight-GPU trial has a sixteen-verifier cap and audio-first validation. This is combined scaling, not a GPU-only causal test.
Cold means a new application cache volume; underlying provider and OS caches are uncontrolled.
Execution resource estimates omit startup/idle, builds, failed trials, storage and network. They are not invoices or total task spending.

failed_trial_longer_private_file_parity.note: Private assembled output after the failed transfer; not a successful cloud-publication timing.
